<cr>On the 22nd of June 1941, the invasion of the Soviet Union began, opening up the Eastern Front and committing Germany to a two front war. The Axis Powers offensive, invading along a 2,900-kilometer front that stretched from the Arctic Ocean in the North to the Black Sea in the South, saw the greatest invasion force ever known to mankind: around 3.8 million men, supported by around 600,000 vehicles and 600,000 horses.<cr>At the start of the invasion, 80% of the available Soviet military forces in the West had been deployed on the border that faced Axis territories as the first strategic echelon. The deployment of the remaining 20% was along the Dvina and Dnieper Rivers as the second echelon and was meant to serve as a spearhead to the Soviet counteroffensive in case of a German invasion.<cr>At the time of the invasion, the Red Army was in the process of reorganisation and modernisation. Its capabilities were greatly reduced from the Purges of the 1930s, strongly affecting the quality of the officer corps. Moreover the standing and morale of the Red Army had been shaken as a result of the Winter War with Finland. On the other hand, after the successful campaigns that had brought Europe to its knees, the German Wehrmacht had consolidated itself as an experienced army, with good training, organisation, and an excellent officer corps.<cr> The titanic struggle between the two major powers and their conflicting ideologies has just begun and it will only end when one of them has been completely destroyed.
column2: <cr>1941年6月22日，苏联入侵行动开始，东线就此开辟，德国由此陷入两线作战。轴心国攻势沿2900公里战线推进，北起北冰洋、南至黑海，投入人类历史上规模最大的入侵兵力：约380万人，另有约60万辆车辆和60万匹战马支援。<cr>入侵开始时，苏军西部可用兵力的80%作为第一战略梯队，部署在面向轴心国领土的边境。其余20%沿德维纳河和第聂伯河部署为第二梯队，原计划在德军入侵时充当苏军反攻的矛头。<cr>入侵之时，红军正处于改编和现代化进程中。1930年代的大清洗大幅削弱了其战力，军官队伍素质受到严重影响。此外，与芬兰的冬季战争动摇了红军的声望和士气。另一方面，在令欧洲屈服的历次成功战役之后，德国国防军已锤炼为一支经验丰富的军队，训练有素、组织严密、军官队伍优秀。<cr>两大强国及其对立意识形态之间的殊死搏斗刚刚开始，只有其中一方被彻底摧毁才会结束。
